objective: Divide dividend by divisor using repeated subtraction and find Quotient and Remainder.
theory: Division (A / B) is accomplished by subtracting B from A repeatedly until A < B. Count of subtractions = Quotient, remaining A = Remainder.
algorithm: 4. Compare A with B (CMP B). If A < B, jump to END.
8. Store Quotient C at 2052H, Remainder A at 2053H.
assembly_code:
MVI C, 00H   ; Clear Quotient counter C
LDA 2050H   ; Load Dividend
MOV B, A
LDA 2051H   ; Load Divisor
MOV D, A    ; D = Divisor
MOV A, B    ; A = Dividend
LOOP: CMP D ; Compare Dividend with Divisor
JC END      ; If A < D, division complete
SUB D       ; Subtract Divisor
INR C       ; Increment Quotient
JMP LOOP    ; Repeat
END: STA 2053H ; Store Remainder
MOV A, C    ;
STA 2052H   ; Store Quotient
HLT
